scope: At each perpetual funding-mark update, retain the public current mark but pass the immediately preceding stored mark to the liquidation sweep. This is a temporary scratch-binary mutation; the source tree was restored before either control or mutant execution.
detector: mvanalyze -metric marginchecks; a coverage-qualified replay from persisted initial accounts, derivative position/balance evidence, and fresh ABC-PERP mark updates. It independently uses math/big for PnL, notional, and maintenance, then compares every predicted breach's mark, cash, PnL contribution, equity, notional, and maintenance against the logged liquidation_check.

active_horizon_provenance.note: The short control equals the retained 24h stress control through its requested active 5h horizon. Its post-horizon terminal quiescence tail is intentionally not compared with the continuing 24h world.

interpretation: A stale liquidation mark can leave the count and mechanics of forced closes unchanged. The independent field-level replay nevertheless detects 14 stale trigger calculations. This validates fresh trigger arithmetic only for the observable one-perpetual, unborrowed-USD cohort; it is not a validation of cross-margin, options, FX collateral, isolated margin, or borrowing.
